description: NaNd₃GeS₇ crystallizes in the hexagonal P6₃ space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent S atoms to form face-sharing NaS₆ octahedra. There are three shorter (2.75 Å) and three longer (2.77 Å) Na-S bond lengths. Nd is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight S atoms. There are a spread of Nd-S bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.21 Å. Ge is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four S atoms. There is one shorter (2.21 Å) and three longer (2.25 Å) Ge-S bond lengths. There are three inequivalent S sites. In the first S site, S is bonded to three equivalent Nd and one Ge atom to form corner-sharing SNd₃Ge tetrahedra. In the second S site, S is bonded to two equivalent Na and four equivalent Nd atoms to form distorted SNa₂Nd₄ pentagonal pyramids that share corners with four equivalent SNa₂Nd₄ pentagonal pyramids, corners with four equivalent SNd₃Ge tetrahedra, and faces with six equivalent SNa₂Nd₄ pentagonal pyramids. In the third S site, S is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three equivalent Nd and one Ge atom.
